summary: Tested 3 new features (Analytics dashboard, Settings/checkpoint upload, Bloch Sphere visualizer). Backend: 13/13 pytest cases passed including new endpoints (/api/stats empty + populated, /api/predict returns 4 bloch_vectors with x/y/z/purity in [-1,1], /api/upload-weights accepts both raw state_dict and wrapped {model_state_dict, epoch} checkpoint formats returning success/weights_loaded/size_bytes). Frontend: All 7 sidebar nav items visible (home/upload/camera/video/history/stats/settings). Analytics page loads with stat-total, stat-latency, stat-fastest, stat-slowest cards + chart-class-distribution (pie), chart-avg-confidence (bar), chart-latency-histogram (bar), chart-timeline (line). refresh-stats reloads. Settings page shows model-status-card (device=cpu, model_loaded=Ready, status=healthy), weight-upload-zone with ckpt-file-input, and untrained-notice. Predict flow now renders bloch-sphere-grid with bloch-sphere-q0..q3 SVGs, x/y/z coords and purity bars, positioned after quantum-circuit-visualizer.

issues: When only 1 class has non-zero counts, the pie chart renders as a lopsided ring; labels for zero-count classes are omitted. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: StatsPage uses raw fetch() instead of the shared api util (utils/api.js) used elsewhere - minor inconsistency.
SettingsPage effect re-fetches /api/health when 'result' changes (dep array [result]) - fine, but a manual refresh button would be cleaner.
server.py /api/upload-weights writes checkpoint synchronously with contents in memory - fine for small .pt files but no size cap; consider MAX_UPLOAD_MB env var.
server.py /api/stats projection excludes bloch_vectors - good for perf; also loads to_list(10000) - add pagination if history grows beyond that.
seed_data_creation: Two /api/predict calls executed during testing (one via pytest, one via UI) leaving ~2 documents in prediction history.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_hqic_api.py now covers /api/stats (empty + populated), bloch_vectors in /api/predict, and /api/upload-weights (both wrapped and raw state_dict). All 13 tests pass in ~5s. Frontend nav-stats/nav-settings and bloch-sphere-grid on ResultDisplay verified via Playwright.
